title: Visual Verification via Demo + Screenshot + CompareGrid
description: Every rendering feature must have a demo under demos/ that can be run with --screenshot to capture output. The screenshot is viewed via Read tool to verify visual correctness. For multi-backend/multi-config testing, CompareGrid composes all screenshots into a single labeled grid image (384x384 cells). Diff mode produces 3-panel comparison (Image A | Image B | Diff Heatmap) with PSNR stats. Screenshots always go to e:/UzEngine/.screenshots/ and are deleted after verification.
example:
# Capture
demo.exe --backend dx12 --screenshot e:/UzEngine/.screenshots/dx12.png
# Compare grid
demo.exe --compose-grid e:/UzEngine/.screenshots/compare.png --cell-size 384 \
  e:/UzEngine/.screenshots/dx12.png "DX12" "Frame 5" \
  e:/UzEngine/.screenshots/dx11.png "DX11" "Frame 5"
# View, verify, delete
rm e:/UzEngine/.screenshots/*.png
whenToUse: After implementing any shader, render pass, post-process effect, or GPU pipeline change. When comparing rendering across DX12/DX11/Vulkan/Metal backends. When regression testing visual quality.
whenNotToUse: For non-visual systems (math utilities, data structures, ECS logic) where unit tests suffice.
